description: Fetch a bitmap stored inside the .fig: pass `hash` (the 40-hex image id reported by fig_node / fig_style on an image paint), or `guid` to take the image(s) used by that node, or hash:"thumbnail" for the document preview. Small images come back as viewable image content; larger ones come back as metadata (mime, byte size, pixel dimensions) — give `savePath` to write the exact bytes to disk instead. NOTE: a .fig contains no rendered pictures of frames, only the bitmaps placed in image fills plus thumbnail.png, so this cannot screenshot a design.

file.description: Path to the .fig / .figma file (absolute, or relative to the server CWD).

guid.description: Node guid; uses the image fills on that node. A Figma node-id or link works too.

hash.description: 40-hex image hash, or the literal "thumbnail" for thumbnail.png.

savePath.description: Write the bytes to this path (parent directories are created) instead of inlining.

name: fig_image
title: Embedded image
